claims.review: 20261005 sector table/physical formula type review: The bilinear is the actual six-site Y tensor with no conjugation on the left state, including the Hermitian-Pauli sign. The actual odd parity involution kills both same-parity terms, and symmetry equates the two mixed terms. The sqrt-two superposition therefore has s(w)=u^T S v. The normalized actual projector and its spin conjugate have trace 2*normSq(u^T S v)/N^2 for arbitrary positive common norm N. No individual amplitude is divided out; the operator identity does not use the final A3-vanishing theorem.
